{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Earth Snake''' (己巳, ''tsuchinoto mi''; onyomi ''ki shi'') is the 6th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|af|Sestigdelige siklus|ar|دورة ستينية|arz|دوره ستينيه|as|ষাঠি বছৰীয়া আৱৰ্তন|ast|Ciclu sexaxenariu|bn|ষাটবার্ষিক চক্র|ca|Cicle sexagesimal|cdo|Găng-ciĕ|cs|Kan-č’|de|60-Jahre-Zyklus|eo|Ĉina sesdekjara ciklo|es|Ciclo sexagesimal chino|eu|Hirurogeitaka urteko ziklo|fa|چرخه شصت‌تایی|fr|Cycle sexagésimal chinois|hak|Kôn-chṳ̂|hy|Վաթսունամյա շրջան|id|Ganzhi|it|Ganzhi|ja|干支|ka|სამოცეული ციკლი|ko|간지|mk|Шеесетгодишен циклус|ms|Ganzhi|nn|Sekstiårig syklus|no|Sekstiårig syklus|ru|Система гань-чжи|sh|Seksagenarni ciklus|simple|Sexagenary cycle|su|Daur séksagenari|sv|Himmelska stammar och jordiska grenar|th|แผนภูมิสวรรค์|tr|Altmışlık döngü|uk|Шістдесятирічний цикл|vi|Can Chi|wuu|干支|xmf|გან-ჩჟიშ სისტემა|za|Gancei|zh|干支|zh_classical|干支|zh_min_nan|Kan-chi|zh_yue|干支|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 6th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Earth Dragon|ja|戊辰}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Metal Horse|ja|庚午}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''己'' is Yin Earth, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|af|Aardtak|als|Erdzweige|az|Türk-monqol təqvimi|ca|Branques terrestres|cdo|Dê-ciĕ|de|Erdzweige|fa|شاخه‌های زمینی|fi|Maalliset oksat|fr|Branche terrestre|gan|地支|hak|Thi-chṳ̂|id|Cabang Bumi|it|Ramo terrestre|ja|十二支|ko|지지 (역법)|mk|Земски гранки|ms|Dizhi|pl|Ziemskie gałęzie|ru|Земные ветви|tr|12 hayvanlı takvim|ug|12 مۆچەل تەقۋىمى|uk|Земні гілки|za|Deihcei|zh|地支|zh_min_nan|Tē-chi|zh_yue|地支|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''巳'' (Snake) is Yin Fire; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|af|Wu Xing|ar|نظرية العناصر الخمسة|bcl|Wu Xing|ca|Cinc processos (Wuxing)|cdo|Ngū-hèng|cs|Pět prvků|da|De fem faser|de|Fünf-Elemente-Lehre|el|Ου Σιν|eo|Skolo de la kvin elementoj|es|Wu Xing|et|Viie elemendi õpetus|fa|وو شینگ|fi|Viisi elementtiä|fr|Wuxing (cosmologie)|gan|五行|hak|Ńg-hàng|he|חמשת היסודות|hu|Öt elem (kínai)|hy|Ու Սին|id|Wu Xing|it|Wu Xing|ja|五行思想|ko|오행|lt|Using|mk|Пет елементи|ms|Wu Xing|nl|Wu Xing|no|De fem elementene|oc|Cinc elements (Wuxing)|pl|Wu xing|pt|Wu Xing|ro|Wu Xing|ru|У-син|simple|Five elements|sk|Učenie o piatich živloch|sl|Pet elementov (vušing)|sq|Wuxing (filozofia kineze)|sr|Пет космичких усмерења|sv|De fem elementen (wu xing)|tl|Limang elemento|tr|Beş element|uk|У-сін|vi|Ngũ hành|wuu|五行|za|Nguxhengz|zh|五行|zh_classical|陰陽五行|zh_min_nan|Ngó͘-hêng|zh_yue|五行|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

* {{ill|Kishii Kikou|ja|己巳紀行}}: a travelogue of the western regions compiled by {{ill|Kaibara Ekken|en|Kaibara Ekken|qid=Q1721396|lt=Kaihara Ekken}} in {{ill|Genroku|ar|فترة غنروكو|cs|Genroku|de|Genroku|es|Genroku|fa|گنروکو|fr|Ère Genroku|id|Genroku|it|Genroku|ja|元禄|ko|겐로쿠|pt|Genroku|ru|Гэнроку|simple|Genroku|sk|Genroku|sr|Генроку|sv|Genroku|tr|Genroku|zh|元祿|qid=Q1325001|lt=Genroku}} 2 (1689 AD), notable for being the first known instance of the term {{ill|Three Views of Japan|en|Three Views of Japan|qid=Q1144867|lt=Japan's Three Views}} (as annotated in 『新日本古典文学大系』 by {{ill|Yōko Itasaka|ja|板坂耀子|qid=Q11532544}}, Iwanami Shoten, 1991).

==Days of Yin Earth Snake==
The {{ill|Senjitsu|ja|選日}} for {{ill|Yin Earth Snake|ja|己巳}} is as follows.
==={{nihongo|selection days|選日|senjitsu}}===
The day of {{ill|Yin Earth Snake|ja|己巳}} is the 2nd day of {{ill|Tsuchi (Japanese term)|ja|犯土|lt=Small Earth|lt_ja=小土|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Small Earth|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11571306}}.
